alerts.title: September, 2026: Fimmvörðuháls hiking trail.
alerts.excerpt: Dangerous conditions at Fimmvörðuháls trail making part of the trail very challenging. People are advised not to hike the trail while the conditions are this way.

alerts.title: Alternative emergency number due to the 2G/3G shutdown
alerts.excerpt: If you are unable to connect to 112, or if the call has poor audio quality or gets disconnected, you can call 599-0112. Save this number as a backup. See further information here: 112.is
